projects.description: A place for you and your bros.
Infinite Commons is the public-safe consumer of Phi-Pantheon artifacts, rendering Commons-ready directory, graph, chronicle, protocol, and bootstrap views from deterministic local handoff bundles.
Super Φ.Vessel (Vessie) is an experimental governed cognitive operating layer for AI systems.
Nested Bubble/Gear (NBG): reproducible experiments in hidden causal residue, interface transport, ordered composition, holonomy, local-to-global structure, and Altermath.
Domistika is an independent browser art application created for artists who want a focused sketching space without subscriptions, locked tools, or device-specific installs.

A local-first music house for Mikey More Bounce / MicTek, with an album vault, listening lounge, visual lab, radio stations, two DJ decks, browser-local favorites and playlists, and a persistent player.
Local-first visual alchemy workstation for image editing, poster forging, style cards, manifests, and auditable creative receipts.
The Silicon Louvre is a public, independent digital museum celebrating imagination, optical art, and human–AI collaboration.

OpenBlueprint Studio is a free, MIT-licensed, local-first blueprint and schematic editor. The v0.1 candidate provides a grid-snapped SVG drafting surface and a live Three.js/WebGL 2 concept preview in a static React app.
a local-first retro Creator OS for building, playtesting, packaging, and evolving small game worlds.
PhiCade is an open-source retro game runtime and emulator front end built around one core idea: every player enters through the same governed runtime seam.

An original browser VR fitness and rave studio.  It combines rhythm targets, music uploads, clans, shared workout rooms, training paths, missions, adaptive coach agents, achievements, and guided recovery.
A full local AI ecosystem that runs on Ollama with a Python/FastAPI chat interface.
PocketBrain is a private, phone-first AI brain that runs locally, remembers locally, and stays under your control.

PorchTalk is the proposed consent-first, budget-aware inference routing policy layer for the Infinite Porch / Infinite Commons ecosystem. It is independently implemented research code, intended to complement PhiOS, PhiPie, Super Φ.Vessel / Crane Fly, BudgetGenius, and PhiStream, not duplicate their runtimes.
